Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 97: June 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #97 shipped to subscribers in May 2009 (bearing the cover date of June 2009 for Issue 97). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #97 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable content, and exclusive previews:

Ghostbusters: The Video Game (third-person action-adventure)
Prototype (open-world action-adventure)
Call of Juarez: Bound in Blood (wild west first-person shooter)
Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen (third-person action)
Marvel vs. Capcom 2 (Xbox Live Arcade 2D fighting game)
Magic: The Gathering – Duels of the Planeswalkers (Xbox Live Arcade collectible card game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics and dashboard themes, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for E3 2009 reveals, Modern Warfare 2, and Halo: Reach, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
